observation: The finite study evaluates a screened molecular potential, preserving three native shared-layout/fast-exponential variants and four gridpoints per workitem. Independent Float64 CPU folds check every potential; positive charges additionally require positive finite results. Native default sets every atomic size to5877, making its exponential argument exceed Float32 range even for maximal unit-cube separation; the original comparison can accept inf-inf NaN differences. This named finite physicalparameterfixture preserves the kernel equation and avoids that invalid default evidence, without asserting full APBS physical validity.
